notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1 just dropped on PC
notes.notes:
[p]Hotfix 1.2.1 for Dying Light: The Beast just dropped on PC, so make sure to update your game! It'll appear on consoles soon![/p][p]The fix addresses the issues with [b]Indoor Rain and the Disturbed Day/Night Cycle[/b].[/p][p]Once the hotfix will be live on all platforms, the [b]APEX Car Skin[/b] will be waiting in the in-game stash for all of you who pre-ordered the game or own it through the Dying Light 2 Ultimate Edition.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and ongoing feedback![/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008130/Dying_Light_The_Beast/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008130/Dying_Light_The_Beast/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1 Update – Indoor Rain & Day/Night Cycle
notes.notes: [p]We’re aware that you're experiencing issues with Indoor Rain and the Disturbed Day/Night Cycle, and fixing them is our top priority.[/p][p]We already have a fix prepared, but because this bug only appears in rare situations, it takes a lot of extra testing.[/p][p]We'll continue these tests over the weekend and most of Monday, and if no new occurrences of this issue appear, we’ll release the hotfix to players right away on PC. This is our goal.[/p][p]If, however, we still spot any occurrences of the bug, we might need to go back, adjust the fix, and then re-test it again.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience. We know these issues are frustrating to those who experience them, and we’re doing everything we can to deliver a stable solution as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008130/Dying_Light_The_Beast/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Incoming Hotfix — Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve seen your feedback about the indoor rain and the disrupted day/night cycle. Our team are already on it and are working through the weekend so the fix will be ready early next week on both PC and consoles.[/p][p]To make this happen as quickly as possible, we had to move the release of the APEX Car Skin to the same patch.[/p][p]As a thank you for your patience, we’re giving you all the Hellhound Shotgun. You can already find it in your in-game stash.  
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157760/8c756564feffd8b5ff9fcc30fc53152a9ce0ea65.png"][/img][/p][p]And don’t forget: by playing for at least 4 hours during the launch weekend, you will also earn the Burning Wolf Axe. Combine both of them to complete your Burning Wolf set. Now, head into Castor Woods, grab these items and UNLEASH THE BEAST![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008130/Dying_Light_The_Beast/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dying Light: The Beast launch times and release date
notes.notes: Dying Light: The Beast is a game about what it's like to try to parkour your way through an undead apocalypse after you've spent years getting injected with zombie juice. Based on the reactions and vengeful affect of returning Dying Light 1 protagonist Kyle Crane, it seems the juice was bad. And yet it helps you kill zombies, so it might be good? Such are the fascinating moral complexities offered by zombie fiction... Read more.

notes.title: Dying Light: The Beast's release date has been moved forward by one whole day
notes.notes: couple of months ago, Techland pushed back the release of first-person zombie kicker Dying Light: The Beast by four weeks "to allow for extra polishing work". I guess that work took less time than they expected, but only slightly less time. After moving the launch back to September 19, it's now been moved forward again. To September 18... Read more.

notes.title: Techland bumps back Dying Light: The Beast release by a month 'to allow for extra polishing work'
notes.notes: Fans of Dying Light 2 will have to wait a little bit longer for the highly anticipated DLC-turned-sequel Dying Light: The Beast. Developer Techland announced on July 24 that the game's release date has been delayed by four weeks, moving it back to September 19... Read more.

notes.title: Dying Light: The Beast Release Date Moves to September 19
notes.notes:
[p]To all the Kyle Crane fans,

As we’re closing in on the launch of Dying Light: The Beast, everyone at the studio feels your excitement. More than 150 previews were published this week from journalists and content creators and their response was universally positive. We’re blushing about quotes like “nailbiting survival horror”, “absolute blast”, “project with a soul” and being called a “standout game of 2025”. It proved the gut feeling that we had already - we’re making a very special, fun game.[/p][p]It also proved that the Dying Light community is the best. The preview coverage has been viewed by millions of players who looked at every detail of the game with laser focus eyes, highlighting, discussing and getting excited about thousands of details. We’re spending time effortlessly, reading and collecting your feedback and opinions and making sure that your voice is heard and we know exactly what’s important for you. [/p][p]It has always been our goal to make Dying Light: The Beast the best Dying Light game we’ve ever released. To honor this promise, we’ve made the decision to move the release date to September 19, 2025 to allow for extra polishing work.[/p][p]We understand that this may be disappointing, but our experience has shown how important the first impression is. With just four additional weeks, we can address final details that make all the difference between good and great. Areas we want to improve include finetuning the balance of gameplay elements, looking into clarity of UI, increasing the quality of physics, as well as tweaking cutscenes and player animations further as well as adding last little details.[/p][p]We’ll keep you busy this summer with regular updates from the studio and a playable demo at gamescom in Hall 6. Starting next week, we’ll also share an update on the game's gore and you’ll meet our good friend Bober the Beaver again.[/p][p]We’re almost there so please bear with us for the remaining 8 weeks – we can’t wait until you finally unleash the Beast on September 19.
[/p][p]With the best regards from the entire team at Techland,
The Developers of Dying Light: The Beast[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dying Light The Beast release date, gameplay, and more
notes.notes:
When is the Dying Light The Beast release date? The newest standalone Dying Light game, now called Dying Light The Beast, originally started out as Dying Light 2 DLC. However, once original protagonist Kyle Crane was brought back and the concept and scale of the expansion grew, Dying Light The Beast spun into a brand-new project.

Dying Light The Beast brings back the horror of Dying Light with terrifying new environments, ties the story in with the first two FPS games, and gives players an introduction to the future of the series.
